mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gov24_public_service (service_id, support_type, service_name, service_purpose_summary, support_target, selection_criteria, support_content, application_method, application_deadline, detail_url, organization_code, organization_name, department_name, view_count, organization_type, user_type, service_category, reception_agency, contact_phone, source_registered_at, source_updated_at, synced_at) VALUES (#{serviceId}, #{supportType}, #{serviceName}, #{servicePurposeSummary}, #{supportTarget}, #{selectionCriteria}, #{supportContent}, #{applicationMethod}, #{applicationDeadline}, #{detailUrl}, #{organizationCode}, #{organizationName}, #{departmentName}, #{viewCount}, #{organizationType}, #{userType}, #{serviceCategory}, #{receptionAgency}, #{contactPhone}, #{sourceRegisteredAt}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE support_type = VALUES(support_type), service_name = VALUES(service_name), service_purpose_summary = VALUES(service_purpose_summary), support_target = VALUES(support_target), selection_criteria = VALUES(selection_criteria), support_content = VALUES(support_content), application_method = VALUES(application_method), application_deadline = VALUES(application_deadline), detail_url = VALUES(detail_url), organization_code = VALUES(organization_code), organization_name = VALUES(organization_name), department_name = VALUES(department_name), view_count = VALUES(view_count), organization_type = VALUES(organization_type), user_type = VALUES(user_type), service_category = VALUES(service_category), reception_agency = VALUES(reception_agency), contact_phone = VALUES(contact_phone), source_registered_at = VALUES(source_registered_at), source_updated_at = VALUES(source_updated_at), synced_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO gov24_public_service_detail (service_id, service_purpose, required_documents, official_verified_documents, identity_verified_documents, reception_agency_name, contact_information, online_application_url, administrative_rules, local_regulations, laws, source_updated_at, synced_at) VALUES (#{serviceId}, #{servicePurpose}, #{requiredDocuments}, #{officialVerifiedDocuments}, #{identityVerifiedDocuments}, #{receptionAgencyName}, #{contactInformation}, #{onlineApplicationUrl}, #{administrativeRules}, #{localRegulations}, #{laws}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE service_purpose = VALUES(service_purpose), required_documents = VALUES(required_documents), official_verified_documents = VALUES(official_verified_documents), identity_verified_documents = VALUES(identity_verified_documents), reception_agency_name = VALUES(reception_agency_name), contact_information = VALUES(contact_information), online_application_url = VALUES(online_application_url), administrative_rules = VALUES(administrative_rules), local_regulations = VALUES(local_regulations), laws = VALUES(laws), source_updated_at = VALUES(source_updated_at), synced_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO gov24_public_service_support_condition (service_id, condition_code, condition_value, synced_at) VALUES (#{serviceId}, #{conditionCode}, #{conditionValue}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE condition_value = VALUES(condition_value), synced_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO local_support_program (source_service_id, source_type, region, program_name, description, summary, agency_name, benefit_summary, target_species, apply_url, period_text, application_method, is_active, source_updated_at, synced_at) VALUES (#{sourceServiceId}, 'GOV24', #{region}, #{programName}, #{description}, #{summary}, #{agencyName}, #{benefitSummary}, #{targetSpecies}, #{applyUrl}, #{periodText}, #{applicationMethod}, 1, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE region = VALUES(region), program_name = VALUES(program_name), description = VALUES(description), summary = VALUES(summary), agency_name = VALUES(agency_name), benefit_summary = VALUES(benefit_summary), target_species = VALUES(target_species), apply_url = VALUES(apply_url), period_text = VALUES(period_text), application_method = VALUES(application_method), is_active = 1, source_updated_at = VALUES(source_updated_at), synced_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT program_id FROM local_support_program WHERE source_service_id = #{sourceServiceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM local_support_program_condition WHERE program_id = #{programId} AND condition_type <> 'MANUAL'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_support_program_condition (program_id, condition_type, operator, condition_value, title, description, is_required, display_order) VALUES (#{programId}, #{conditionType}, #{operator}, #{conditionValue}, #{title}, #{description}, #{isRequired}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE local_support_program SET is_active = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE source_type = 'GOV24' AND is_active = 1
